# Soundways to Health

> Complementary wellness sessions with Shri Vivek in Mississauga, Ontario and across the GTA.

## Services

- Sound Healing — Himalayan and crystal singing bowls, gongs, tuning forks and handpan. Individual sessions are $80 CAD; group and corporate sessions are quoted by size and format. https://soundwaystohealth.com/sound-healing.html
- Access Bars — gentle 32-point head-touch sessions. First visit $110 CAD, return session $85 CAD, Bars + Sound $160 CAD. https://soundwaystohealth.com/access-bars.html
- Compassion Key — guided compassion work for fear, anxiety and old hurt. Single session $140 CAD; couples or family session $220 CAD. This is a complementary practice, not psychotherapy or medical treatment. https://soundwaystohealth.com/compassion-key.html

Sessions are available in the Mississauga studio, by GTA home visit, or online where offered. Outcomes vary and no result is guaranteed.

## Practitioner

Shri Vivek — Certified Compassion Key Practitioner, Accredited Enneagram Practitioner, and trained sound healing and Access Bars facilitator.
